note: the export-local-to-reconstruction transform: how a block coordinate actually read out of the litematic file maps back to a cell on transform.json's camera-space lattice. minimum_shift is added to a read-back local block coordinate before block_to_cell (see export/litematic.py - a single-region file always stores Position (0,0,0) and its shape local to its own minimum corner). face_coordinate/lateral_origin/period are the arbitrary local export convention cell_to_block/block_to_cell use, distinct from the continuous camera transform.
